tasks.title: Settings module via pydantic-settings and secret hygiene

tasks.title: Docker Compose topology: Postgres, Prefect server, Prefect worker
acceptance_criteria: postgres service (warehouse), prefect-server service (API/UI), prefect-worker service (runs deployments) (Req 9.2, AC1).

prefect-server is its own Compose service; worker connects to it (Req 5.1, Q5/Q18).
Connection settings are environment-driven and match the settings module defaults (Req 8).

tasks.title: bronze_members YAML data contract and coverage-checking loader
tasks.verification_cmd: uv run --directory congress_pipeline ruff check . && uv run --directory congress_pipeline mypy src && uv run --directory congress_pipeline pytest tests/unit/test_contract_loader.py
acceptance_criteria: Checked-in vendor-neutral YAML contract is the single source of truth (Req 7, AC4).

Contract clauses: required fields present (bioguideId, name, partyName, state, updateDate, url); type checks; partyName in {Democratic, Republican, Independent}; bioguideId matches ^[A-Z]\d{6}$; updateDate parses as ISO-8601; pagination/count consistency (Req 7).
Freshness is explicitly NOT a bronze contract clause (Req 5.3, Req 7).
Loader asserts the GE suite covers every clause in the contract (Req 7, AC4).
GE is the enforcement engine, the contract is the authority; loader is decoupled from GE internals (Req 7).

tasks.title: Bronze schema: immutable raw payload ledger plus latest-state table
tasks.verification_cmd: uv run --directory congress_pipeline ruff check . && uv run --directory congress_pipeline mypy src && uv run --directory congress_pipeline pytest tests/unit/test_bronze.py
acceptance_criteria: bronze schema holds immutable raw JSONB payloads (list + detail) plus ingestion run metadata (Req 4, Req 6.1).
Raw Payload = one append-only row per fetch, keyed by run + bioguideId; full JSONB retained (Req 6.1, Req 5.2).
Latest-state convenience table stores current signature/updateDate per member (Req 5.2).
Append-only ledger is never updated in place; every fetched payload retained immutably and replayable (Req 11).
Layer boundaries enforced by schema isolation (bronze separate from silver/gold) (Req 11).

tasks.title: Congress.gov API client: pagination, rate limits, backoff
tasks.verification_cmd: uv run --directory congress_pipeline ruff check . && uv run --directory congress_pipeline mypy src && uv run --directory congress_pipeline pytest tests/unit/test_pagination.py
acceptance_criteria: List endpoint enumerated with limit=250 and offset pagination; detail endpoint fetched per bioguideId (Req 3, Req 5.2).
Pagination loop terminates on next cursor; never requests limit>250 (Req 3 fact: 251 clamped to 250).
Respects 20,000 req/hr with 429/5xx backoff; worst-case sweep ~1,100 requests stays far below the cap (Req 11, AC14).
No date-range incremental cursor is trusted (updateDate ignored per ADR-0002) (Req 3, Req 12).
Unit tests cover pagination assembly and backoff behavior with a mocked transport.

tasks.title: Payload-derived change detection with change signature
tasks.verification_cmd: uv run --directory congress_pipeline ruff check . && uv run --directory congress_pipeline mypy src && uv run --directory congress_pipeline pytest tests/unit/test_change_detection.py
acceptance_criteria: Full sweep compares a per-member signature against latest bronze state and fetches detail only for new/changed members (Req 5.2, AC3, ADR-0002).
List updateDate is a cheap pre-filter; detail payload hash is authoritative (Req 12 Q13/Q14).
Unchanged members produce no duplicate rows (AC3, Req 11).
Signature is deterministic and stable across dict key ordering (Req 12 Q3).
Unit tests cover new, changed, and unchanged member scenarios.

tasks.title: Idempotent raw landing for bronze payloads
tasks.verification_cmd: uv run --directory congress_pipeline ruff check . && uv run --directory congress_pipeline mypy src && uv run --directory congress_pipeline pytest tests/unit/test_ingest_idempotency.py
acceptance_criteria: Idempotent upsert keyed on bioguideId (Req 5.2, Req 11).
Re-running a completed day's load leaves bronze row counts unchanged (AC13).
Raw landing writes append-only ledger plus latest-state convenience row (Req 5.2).
Unit test simulates a repeat run and asserts no duplicate bronze rows.

tasks.title: Prefect sweep flow: daily full sweep and parameterized backfill
tasks.verification_cmd: uv run --directory congress_pipeline ruff check . && uv run --directory congress_pipeline mypy src && uv run --directory congress_pipeline pytest tests/unit/test_flows.py
acceptance_criteria: Flow tasks: enumerate members (paginated), fetch detail, land raw, run GE checkpoint, dbt run, dbt snapshot, gold checks, emit run summary (Req 5.1).
Daily deployment sweeps all current members (~539) landing raw payloads in bronze (AC2).
Backfill deployment is manual and parameterized to bootstrap activity from 2026-01-01 (Req 5.2, AC8).
Change detection gates detail fetches so unchanged members are not refetched (AC3).
Structured logs and a run summary artifact are emitted (Req 11).

tasks.title: Great Expectations bronze checkpoint (fail-closed) and contract coverage
tasks.verification_cmd: uv run --directory congress_pipeline ruff check . && uv run --directory congress_pipeline mypy src && uv run --directory congress_pipeline pytest tests/unit/test_ge_contract_coverage.py
acceptance_criteria: GE validates bronze immediately after load against the checked-in contract (Req 5.3, AC4).
Bronze checkpoint is fail-closed: a contract breach halts the pipeline before silver/gold (Req 5.3, AC5).
A deliberately corrupted payload is rejected by the checkpoint and the run halts (AC5).
Loader proves GE suite covers every contract clause (Req 7, AC4).
Freshness is not enforced at bronze; it is a gold/monitoring SLA check (alert-only) (Req 5.3).

tasks.title: dbt project and silver staging model (one current row per member)

stg_members is typed, renamed, deduplicated, one row per member current-state (Req 5.4, AC6).
dbt tests enforce silver invariants: uniqueness, not-null, accepted values (Req 5.4).
dbt_utils is declared in packages.yml for surrogate keys (Req 6.2).
dbt parse succeeds against profiles.yml.

tasks.title: Gold marts: member_terms and member_party_history at natural grain
tasks.verification_cmd: uv run --directory congress_pipeline dbt parse --project-dir dbt --profiles-dir dbt
acceptance_criteria: member_terms is at term grain (bioguideId, congress, chamber, startYear) sourced from detail terms[] (Req 6.1, AC6).
member_party_history is at party-affiliation grain (bioguideId, partyAbbreviation, startYear) sourced from detail partyHistory[] (Req 6.1, AC6).
Array-valued history is modeled at natural grain, not SCD2-tracked (Req 6.2).
Gold tests enforce uniqueness, not-null, and relationships to dim_member (Req 5.4).

tasks.title: SCD2 dim_member snapshot on scalar member attributes
tasks.verification_cmd: uv run --directory congress_pipeline dbt parse --project-dir dbt --profiles-dir dbt
acceptance_criteria: Full SCD2 on scalar attributes: name fields, state, district, current party, currentMember flag, birth year, honorific (Req 6.2, AC6).
Change trigger is a dbt_utils.generate_surrogate_key hash over the tracked scalar set; on change close current version and open new (Req 6.2, AC7).
A simulated attribute change produces exactly one new SCD2 version with correct valid-from/valid-to (AC7).
Terms/partyHistory arrays are not SCD2-tracked (Req 6.2).
Tracked-attribute set is provisional and documented as refinable (Req 6.2).
